english.toefl: 80 with each section 18 before January 21,2026; 4 with each section 4 after that date
english.note: IELTS each section 6.5; DET literacy/comprehension/conversation/production 110. TA speaking requirements are higher. Scores within 24 months of entry. Exemptions: listed English-language citizenship or one year full-time US degree study with GPA 3.0; overseas English-medium degree alone is not listed.

requirements.note: Bachelor in biology/related field usually expected; PhD GPA 3.2 and research experience highly recommended. Typical supporting courses: biology 6, chemistry 4, physics 2, mathematics 2. Faculty adviser must be identified and request application review.

funding.note: Catalog says Biology does not accept MS/PhD students without support. Teaching/research assistantships available; amount, covered costs and duration not specified.
